wants.topic: Emotional Durga / Navratri miracle stories involving vulnerable devotees tested or saved by the Goddess
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio's video 'माँ दुर्गा से आखिर क्यों बूढ़ी औरत ने करवाया खूब काम?' hit 287x normal views (6.3M views); top 3 best videos all revolve around dramatic Maa Durga devotee miracles.

wants.topic: Modern saint miracles presented as divine reincarnations (e.g., Neem Karoli Baba as Hanuman Avtar)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's 4K movie on Neem Karoli Baba reached 11.4M views (44.1x vsNormal) and a full movie followup did 20.5x vsNormal.

wants.topic: Lesser-known Puranic backstories and dramatic tests of chastity/power (Sati, Sati Anasuya, Satyavati & Parashar)
wants.evidence: Mystery of the World achieved 42.6x vsNormal with 'ब्रह्मा जी से सती ने छीने पति के प्राण' and 30.2x with Satyavati/Parashar Rishi.

wants.topic: Provocative apologetics and defensive Hindu faith questions addressing common doubts or myths
wants.evidence: Bk Usha Motivational video 'हिंदू धर्म में इतने भगवान और दूसरे धर्म में एक ही भगवान क्यों?' achieved 151.4x vsNormal (1.7M views); 'मक्का में शिवजी' got 47.3x vsNormal.

wants.topic: High-stakes Swayamvar and 'impossible task' folk/mythological AI stories
wants.evidence: THE BH STORIES generated 5.2M views (39x vsNormal) across multiple parts using 'घमंडी राजकुमारी का स्वयंवर: 5 असंभव शर्तें'.

gaps: High-production cinematic/4K AI animated kathas focused on modern modern-era saints and localized miracles (e.g., Neem Karoli Baba, Shirdi Sai, Gajanan Maharaj) tied directly to main Hindu avatars.
Dramatic, emotionally charged narrative portrayals of female Puranic figures (Sati, Satyavati, Anasuya, Vrinda) focusing on intense divine conflicts rather than simple recitations.
Clear, respectful apologetics answering modern faith questions with engaging visual storytelling rather than simple talking-head lectures.
saturated: Generic 'Moral Story' videos lacking iconic mythological gods or specific scriptural roots (e.g., generic stories like 'Thakur ji and Bhondu' underperformed at 0.09x).
Dry historical documentaries without high mythic/emotional hooks (e.g., standard Chanakya/Chandragupta history performed at 0.18x vsNormal).
Absurd or overly fictionalized fairy-tale AI stories featuring nonsensical animal pairings (e.g., Princess marrying turtle/gorilla flopped at 0.09x-0.23x).
Dense, abstract philosophical lectures without sensational or relatable hooks (e.g., Karma Yoga vs Sannyasa Yoga flopped at 0.23x).
